specs.英文简介: The Reflex-Nettel is a 9x12 cm size folding plate reflex camera with a focal-plane shutter, made by the German company Nettel Camerawerk c.1914[https://resolver.kb.nl/resolve?urn=MMNFM01:015843021:00008 Article "Fotografische Nieuwigheden" (Photography News)] as published in the October 1914 issue of the Dutch photography magazine "Lux".
